name: turn-meter
description: Shows how long each turn took, how many tools it used in the main thread and in subagents, and the tokens it spent, in a band above the prompt, and alerts you when a long turn ends.

alert.title: Long-turn alert
alert.description: How to alert you when a main turn runs longer than the threshold: toast shows a message inside Claude Code, notify sends a native notification through your terminal (falling back to a toast when none can be sent), off sends nothing.

alertAfterSeconds.title: Alert after (seconds)
alertAfterSeconds.description: A main turn that runs at least this many seconds triggers the long-turn alert.

showTokens.title: Show tokens
showTokens.description: Show the tokens the last turn spent in the band. Turn it off to see only time and tools.
